{"title":"2026 两季度区域收入 / 成本 / 毛利率","source":"{@body const DATA = [{region:"华东",q:"2026Q1",revenue:128400,cost:76200,orders:1840},{region:"华北",q:"2026Q1",revenue:98450,cost:61300,orders:1320},{region:"华南",q:"2026Q1",revenue:152300,cost:88900,orders:2115},{region:"西南",q:"2026Q1",revenue:61200,cost:42800,orders:760},{region:"东北",q:"2026Q1",revenue:43750,cost:33100,orders:540},{region:"华东",q:"2026Q2",revenue:141200,cost:80100,orders:1975},{region:"华北",q:"2026Q2",revenue:105900,cost:64200,orders:1408},{region:"华南",q:"2026Q2",revenue:168750,cost:94100,orders:2280},{region:"西南",q:"2026Q2",revenue:68400,cost:45900,orders:845},{region:"东北",q:"2026Q2",revenue:48200,cost:35700,orders:596}]} {@body const [metric,setMetric] = DIL.useState("revenue")} {@body const [view,setView] = DIL.useState("region")} {@body const pct = (r,c) => r===0?0:((r-c)/r*100)} {@body const fmt = n => n.toLocaleString("en-US")} {@body const REGIONS = ["华东","华北","华南","西南","东北"]} {@body const QUARTERS = ["2026Q1","2026Q2"]} {@body const byRegion = REGIONS.map(r=>{const q1=DATA.find(d=>d.region===r&&d.q==="2026Q1");const q2=DATA.find(d=>d.region===r&&d.q==="2026Q2");return {name:r,q1:q1.revenue,q2:q2.revenue,c1:q1.cost,c2:q2.cost,m1:pct(q1.revenue,q1.cost),m2:pct(q2.revenue,q2.cost),g1:q1.revenue-q1.cost,g2:q2.revenue-q2.cost}})} {@body const tot = DATA.reduce((a,d)=>({revenue:a.revenue+d.revenue,cost:a.cost+d.cost,orders:a.orders+d.orders}),{revenue:0,cost:0,orders:0})} {@body const gross = tot.revenue-tot.cost} {@body const gm = pct(tot.revenue,tot.cost)} {@body const qt = QUARTERS.map(q=>{const rows=DATA.filter(d=>d.q===q);const rev=rows.reduce((a,d)=>a+d.revenue,0);const cst=rows.reduce((a,d)=>a+d.cost,0);return {name:q,revenue:rev,cost:cst,gross:rev-cst,gm:pct(rev,cst)}})} {@body const chartRows = view==="region" ? byRegion.map(r=>({name:r.name,2026Q1:metric==="revenue"?r.q1:r.c1,2026Q2:metric==="revenue"?r.q2:r.c2})) : qt.map(q=>({name:q.name,2026Q1:0,2026Q2:0}))} {@body const marginRows = byRegion.map(r=>({name:r.name,"2026Q1":+r.m1.toFixed(1),"2026Q2":+r.m2.toFixed(1)}))} {@body const metricLabel = metric==="revenue"?"收入":"成本"} 2026 上半年区域经营概览 sales-2026.csv · 10 行 总收入 ¥{fmt(tot.revenue)} 总成本 ¥{fmt(tot.cost)} 毛利 / 毛利率 ¥{fmt(gross)} {gm.toFixed(1)}% {#if view==="region"} {:else} 季度 收入 成本 毛利 毛利率 {#each qt as q} {q.name} ¥{fmt(q.revenue)} ¥{fmt(q.cost)} ¥{fmt(q.gross)} {q.gm.toFixed(1)}% {/each} 合计 ¥{fmt(tot.revenue)} ¥{fmt(tot.cost)} ¥{fmt(gross)} {gm.toFixed(1)}%
{/if} 区域 Q1 收入 Q1 成本 Q1 毛利率 Q2 收入 Q2 成本 Q2 毛利率 毛利率变动 {#each byRegion as r} {r.name} ¥{fmt(r.q1)} ¥{fmt(r.c1)} {r.m1.toFixed(1)}% ¥{fmt(r.q2)} ¥{fmt(r.c2)} {r.m2.toFixed(1)}% =0?"success":"danger"}>{(r.m2-r.m1>=0?"+":"")+(r.m2-r.m1).toFixed(1)}pp {/each}
口径：毛利率 = (收入 − 成本) / 收入；总毛利率按合计口径计算，非各区域简单平均。两季度合计订单 {fmt(tot.orders)} 单。 "}
